selection: Next 20 stable seed IDs, P021–P040; continuation of the convenience pilot, not a database-derived or random sample.
reviewer: Codex AI-assisted preliminary triage; human adjudication pending for every record.
decision_rule: Conservative advancement on a documented scope signal. Partial full-text inspection supports only the named findings, not full eligibility or all feature codes.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract; journal citation not independently rechecked in this batch
records.criterion_3: Joint acquisition-parameter calibration and reconstruction
records.evidence: Differentiable interpolation of a measurement representation enables joint estimation of sensor coordinates and the reconstructed object, with tomography applications.
records.full_text_question: Which coordinate errors and initialization regimes are evaluated? Physical calibration is not statistical calibration of uncertainty intervals.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract and authors' institutional publication record
records.criterion_3: Blind operator estimation using diffusion and expectation maximization
records.evidence: Diffusion sampling supplies an approximate E-step, while the M-step estimates a blur kernel with an optional plug-and-play kernel prior. A faster variant reduces sampling cost.
records.full_text_question: Does uncertainty describe only image samples conditional on a point-estimated kernel, or propagate kernel uncertainty? Extract assumed kernel/noise families.

metadata.Title: Fast Diffusion EM: A Diffusion Model for Blind Inverse Problems With Application to Deconvolution
metadata.Authors: Laroche, Charles; Almansa, Andrés; Coupete, Eva

records.basis: Author preprint abstract and official proceedings record
records.criterion_3: Blind degradation estimation and image restoration
records.evidence: BIRD optimizes degradation parameters and initial diffusion noise through fast diffusion inversion, seeking restoration within a generative image prior.
records.full_text_question: Which degradation combinations and mismatched families are tested? Optimization on a generative manifold does not itself certify measurement-supported detail.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract; journal lineage reconciled with the existing verification audit
records.criterion_3: Joint image and unknown-operator recovery
records.evidence: LatentDEM combines latent diffusion with expectation maximization for blind deblurring and sparse-view inverse rendering. The 2024 preprint and 2026 TIP report remain one study.
records.full_text_question: Inspect the final journal report for additions, operator constraints and uncertainty evaluation; the DOI remains unverified and is not invented.

records.basis: Publisher chapter abstract
records.criterion_3: Blind restoration with a generative prior
records.evidence: DiffBIR separates degradation removal from diffusion-based detail generation and provides guidance to adjust fidelity. It evaluates several restoration tasks with synthetic and real inputs.
records.full_text_question: How is fidelity measured, and are unsupported details assessed against ground truth? The former ECCV poster URL pointed to the unrelated CLOSER paper.

records.basis: Official proceedings record and targeted full-text inspection of sections 4.1–4.2
records.criterion_3: Compound, unknown and time-varying video degradation
records.evidence: AverNet explicitly evaluates changing combinations of noise, blur, JPEG and video compression. The experimental setup overlaps our proposed surveillance-style simulation.
records.full_text_question: Separate new degradation combinations and change intervals from genuinely unseen operator families or cameras; verify any reliability claims beyond PSNR/SSIM.

records.basis: Official BMVC proceedings abstract and citation
records.criterion_3: Codec-dependent restoration and generalization
records.evidence: SR+Codec benchmarks 19 super-resolution models across five video codecs, with perceptual assessment and codec-transfer evaluation.
records.full_text_question: Can its codec transfer protocol support a controlled degradation-shift experiment? It studies bitrate reduction, not forensic reconstruction. The former arXiv URL was an unrelated SLAM paper.

metadata.Title: SR+Codec: a Benchmark of Super-Resolution for Video Compression Bitrate Reduction
metadata.Authors: Bogatyrev, Evgeney; Molodetskikh, Ivan; Vatolin, Dmitriy S.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract with CVPR acceptance identified
records.criterion_3: Generative restoration of unknown real-world degradation
records.evidence: SUPIR scales a generative restoration model and uses text conditioning and restoration guidance to balance perceptual quality and fidelity.
records.full_text_question: How do prompts and prior strength affect invented detail? Extract quantitative fidelity tests and inference costs before choosing a baseline.

records.basis: Paper abstract indexed by PubMed and publisher citation
records.criterion_3: Explicit model-mismatch and noise robustness
records.evidence: MN-FISTA-Net unrolls an optimization method using mixed-norm regularization and a learned denoiser for lensless reconstruction affected by model error and noise.
records.full_text_question: Which PSF errors are held out, and does the design distinguish noise from operator error? Extract any real-system validation.

records.basis: Authors' institutional publication abstract and author list
records.criterion_3: Bayesian reconstruction uncertainty
records.evidence: The empirical Bayes procedure estimates a low-resolution representation and samples high-resolution reconstructions through a conditional generative prior; deblurring illustrates the approach.
records.full_text_question: What uncertainty is lost by conditioning on an estimated representation, and what calibration or shift tests are reported?

metadata.Authors: Melidonis, S.; Holden, M.; Altmann, Y.; Pereyra, M.; Zygalakis, K. C.

records.basis: Publisher abstract
records.criterion_3: Hallucination and accuracy–stability limits
records.evidence: The work analyzes how inverse-problem kernels and ill-conditioning constrain reconstruction accuracy, stability and hallucinations across reconstruction methods.
records.full_text_question: State the theorem assumptions and operational examples precisely; do not generalize a worst-case limitation into universal failure of every learned method.

metadata.Title: The Troublesome Kernel: On Hallucinations, No Free Lunches, and the Accuracy-Stability Tradeoff in Inverse Problems

records.basis: Publisher title and indexed abstract excerpt only; complete abstract and full text blocked by retrieval challenges
records.criterion_3: Uncertain acquisition in Fourier ptychographic reconstruction; conservative scope signal
records.evidence: The title and indexed evidence place the study within uncertainty-aware Fourier ptychographic reconstruction. The available evidence is insufficient to validate the seed matrix's image-UQ, operator-UQ or calibration ratings.
records.full_text_question: Retrieve the complete paper. Does uncertainty mean uncertain acquisition parameters, probabilistic posterior uncertainty, or both? Existing positive feature codes remain unverified.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Distribution-shift detection in inverse problems
records.evidence: The method uses corrupted observations and diffusion scores to estimate a distribution discrepancy and adapt score alignment for reconstruction.
records.full_text_question: Distinguish image-prior shift from acquisition-operator shift; identify the detection unit, assumptions and validated thresholds.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract; final conference metadata still pending
records.criterion_3: Instance-level distribution-shift uncertainty
records.evidence: Measurement-perturbation sensitivity is proposed as a calibration-free shift indicator, illustrated by an MNIST experiment with a restricted training class.
records.full_text_question: Does it generalize to natural images and unseen acquisition families? Calibration-free estimation is not a coverage guarantee. Resolve the CAMSAP lineage before locking metadata.

records.basis: Authors' institutional abstract and complete proceedings metadata
records.criterion_3: Learned residual compensation for forward-model mismatch
records.evidence: A shallow network learns discrepancies between measurements and model predictions, providing adaptive guidance to diffusion reconstruction. The record identifies SPIE volume 14016, article 140160D, published in February 2026.
records.full_text_question: Can a flexible residual absorb noise or unsupported image detail? Extract identifiability constraints, optimization and held-out mismatch tests.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Controlled operator-mismatch benchmark and calibration
records.evidence: InverseNet compares reconstruction and calibration regimes across three compressive imaging modalities with simulated scenes and real captures.
records.full_text_question: Inspect operator access, mismatch generation, data splits and released resources. Acquisition calibration must not be coded automatically as uncertainty calibration.

records.basis: Author abstract and targeted full-text definitions, Remark 3.4, Proposition 3.5 and Algorithm 2
records.criterion_3: Formal hallucination assessment and feasibility limits
records.evidence: The paper relates hallucination assessment to the diameter of feasible solutions. Its finite-sample diameter estimate approaches the complete-set diameter from below and is not directly a pointwise upper certificate.
records.full_text_question: What operational guarantee survives approximate sampling and an estimated acquisition model? The seed abstention code is not established by these inspected sections.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract and targeted full-text sections 2–3, Tables 1–3 and Figures 3–4; conference lineage retained
records.criterion_3: Joint image/kernel posterior sampling and uncertainty evaluation
records.evidence: PRISM evaluates both image and kernel uncertainty, including image Gaussian NLL and a credible-interval example. Joint blind inference plus uncertainty is therefore already a substantive competitor capability.
records.full_text_question: Does the final conference report test interval reliability under unseen operator families? The inspected experiment establishes neither arbitrary-shift coverage nor a deployed selective-output mechanism.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract and publisher journal metadata
records.criterion_3: Blind all-in-one restoration with composite and unseen degradation
records.evidence: ABAIR learns degradation representations and blends low-rank restoration adapters, evaluating composite and unseen distortions.
records.full_text_question: Which distortions are truly held out, and are uncertainty, temporal behavior or selective risk assessed? Composite/OOD restoration alone is an occupied direction.

records.basis: Authors' institutional paper abstract and official repository experiment descriptions
records.criterion_3: Blind video reconstruction under dynamic physical degradation
records.evidence: VDPS combines an approximate scattering model, video diffusion and inference-time parameter estimation. The official repository documents both static and time-varying blind Zernike experiments; these were not executed in this batch.
records.full_text_question: Inspect the final paper, uncertainty treatment, changing-PSF assumptions and real-capture validation. Video plus joint time-varying operator recovery alone cannot be claimed as new.

revisits.basis: Targeted inspection of section 6 in the author PDF
revisits.note: The inspected experiments cover Gaussian deblurring, compressed sensing and MRI. A criterion-3 mismatch/reliability study is still not established. Retain unclear for human scope adjudication; this is not an exclusion or full-text eligibility decision.

revisits.basis: Retrieval retry unsuccessful: OpenReview challenge and author-PDF fetch failure
revisits.note: No additional substantive evidence retrieved. Keep the prior unclear recommendation and incomplete-evidence label; missing access is not an exclusion.
